scenario: Tapping GLO opens the song page, where the key, tempo and length change and nothing played does
name: companion: C4 recorded on CHORDS PLAY; GLO tapped opens the song page; K1 locks D major, K2 100 BPM, K3 2 bars; GLO again back to PLAY, whose key lights are now D major's (D half, F# A C# dim, C and F off); the recorded C4 still plays when the 2-bar loop comes round
note: Before K3 the loop is 4 bars at 90 BPM (10656 ms); at 100 BPM and 2 bars it is 4800 ms, and the C4 recorded at tick ~7 comes round near 1000 + 4800 + 240 = 6040 ms (the tempo change keeps the place in the loop, so a little later). Without the recording it would be silent there.
